About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

At DiDi, we are building something special, and we want the world to know it. We believe in creativity, connection, and the power of a killer digital strategy. We’re looking for a creative, internet-obsessed, and driven Social Media Intern to join our Regional Social Media Marketing team.

If you live on TikTok, know exactly why a specific audio is trending, and understand how community drives brand loyalty, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

In this role, you'll be...

As our Social Media Intern, you won't just be fetching coffee or scheduling boring posts. You will be in the driver’s seat of our community presence, helping us scale our hyper-local footprints and collaborating with incredible creators. You will work closely with our core marketing team and external agency partners to turn big ideas into viral realities.

Key Responsibilities


Community Management: Be the voice of our brand. You’ll engage with our followers, spark conversations, and turn casual scrollers into brand evangelists.
Influencer Marketing Management: Source, approve and review local and macro-influencers. You'll manage the outreach pipeline and ensure creators deliver content that hits the mark in partnership with our influencer agency. 
City-Based Campaigns: You will assist in brainstorming and executing hyper-targeted, city-specific campaigns to build local buzz and offline-to-online engagement.
Agency Coordination: Act as a bridge between our internal team and our paid media agency. You'll help coordinate our boosting/paid social efforts to ensure our top-performing organic content gets the budget it deserves.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Unapologetic Passion: You genuinely love social media and influencer culture. You understand the nuances of different platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) and what makes content shareable.
A Creative Mindset: You can spot trends before they hit the mainstream and know how to adapt them to a brand voice.
Organization Skills: Juggling multiple influencers and city campaigns requires a sharp eye for detail and great time management.
Analytical Curiosity: Note: While basic knowledge of social analytics is a massive plus to help us track our social media impact, it is not mandatory. We are more than happy to teach you the ropes if you bring the data-curious mindset!



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

Are you someone who thrives in high-expectation environments — someone who has built your career in places where the bar is high, the pace is fast, and excellence is the norm — and now wants to apply that same rigor to building and growing a portfolio of consumer brands?




We’re looking for a Brand Strategy & Growth Manager who pairs sharp commercial thinking with real instinct for brand, product, and consumer. This person can look across a portfolio of brands, identify the opportunities that will move them forward — whether in brand, product, marketing, or anywhere else growth is hiding — and drive the work from first idea to real results.




You’re sharp, resourceful, and reliable under pressure. You’ve likely spent the first 2–4 years of your career in a demanding, results-driven environment — consulting, a top tech or CPG company, a brand incubator, a high-growth consumer startup, or an equally rigorous organization — where structured thinking, accountability, and speed were expected. You have genuine taste and strong instincts for what makes a brand and product compelling, but you lead with commercial judgment: you’re a business person first, not a designer.




Now you’re looking to apply that intensity in a role with real ownership, variety, and visibility, working directly with the CEO.




This role is for someone who:

Brings structured, commercial thinking to brand, product, and growth decisions.
Has direct experience with consumer brands and understands how brand, product, marketing, and commercial performance connect.
Takes full ownership of a wide range of initiatives and figures out which ones are worth pursuing in the first place.
Moves fluidly between big-picture strategy and the hands-on details that make it real.
Has taste and a point of view, but grounds every creative instinct in business logic.
Thrives in an environment where the pace is fast and the standards are high.




If you want a role where you’ll work directly with the CEO across everything that grows our brands — and where your impact will be visible across the company — this is it.




The Role

You’ll report directly to the CEO and act as a force multiplier across the portfolio — the person we point at whatever will most improve our brands and drive growth.

Some of the work is brand: sharpening how a brand shows up and what it stands for. Some of it is product: spotting white space and leading a new launch from concept to shelf. Some of it is marketing: standing up the social, influencer, and campaign work that moves the needle. And plenty of it won’t fit neatly into any one of those buckets — a project to improve how we run a brand, a new process, a new asset, or an opportunity no one has spotted yet.

Your job is to find the highest-leverage work and go do it.




Key Responsibilities

Brand positioning & equity: Own how each brand shows up — what it stands for, how it’s positioned, and the messaging and consumer experience behind it.
Product development: Research the category and competitors, define the features that matter, push contract manufacturers and supply chain toward the right quality and cost, and take products from concept to shelf.
Marketing & growth: Identify the messaging, channels, and campaigns most likely to grow a brand — social, influencer, content, and beyond — then develop them and prove they moved the number.
Creative direction: Write copy yourself and direct the creative team on packaging, assets, and storytelling.
Opportunity identification: Pressure-test where the highest-leverage moves across the portfolio are, and build the case for what’s worth doing.
Whatever moves the needle: Take on high-priority projects across the business — wherever sharp thinking and real ownership will drive growth.




Requirements

2–4 years of experience in a high-expectation, analytical, and execution-driven environment, such as consulting, investment banking, private equity, consumer tech, CPG, a brand incubator, a high-growth consumer startup, or an equally rigorous organization.
Direct experience with consumer brands, ideally across beauty, wellness, home, Amazon / marketplace businesses, retail, e-commerce, or another fast-moving consumer category.
Strong commercial judgment and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, identify high-leverage opportunities, and turn ideas into clear action plans.
Experience launching, scaling, or improving brand, product, marketing, content, or e-commerce growth initiatives.
Strong brand, product, and consumer instincts, with an eye for what makes products, messaging, campaigns, packaging, and creative commercially effective.
Demonstrated ability to own projects end-to-end, from research and analysis through execution, follow-up, and measurement of results.
Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to write clear recommendations, briefs, copy, internal updates, and executive-ready summaries.
High ownership, speed, reliability, and attention to detail in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and high standards.




About the Company

Cove Brands is a profitable consumer brand group at the beginning of an ambitious next chapter across beauty, wellness, and home. Our portfolio blends the performance mindset of an e-commerce operator with the creativity of a brand incubator — data-driven, brand-obsessed, and moving quickly into national retail.

We keep our team small, our standards high, and our goals ambitious. Every person here plays a visible role in shaping strategy, creative, and growth — driving measurable impact on the brands we’re building.

About the job

Comprador(a) Estratégico(a) | Fundador(a) del Departamento de Compras — RIVUS®




Ubicación: Querétaro, Qro. o Monterrey, Nuevo León.

Reporta a: Dirección General 

Tipo: Tiempo completo




Si buscas un reto profesional que desarrolle una mejor versión de ti y sea tangiblemente de alto impacto, esta oportunidad va a ser interesante para ti.




En RIVUS® creemos que la venta se construye desde la compra inteligente, oportuna y pro-mercado.




Debido al crecimiento de la compañía, estamos en busqueda de la persona que va a construir desde cero la función de Compras Estratégicas para convertirla en una ventaja competitiva real.




Este es un rol fundacional. Tendrás la página en blanco, la confianza directa de la Dirección General y el mandato de definir la estrategia, los procesos y el criterio con el que RIVUS® comprará durante los próximos años.




¿De qué trata el reto?

RIVUS® está creciendo, y con ese crecimiento viene la oportunidad de profesionalizar y elevar cómo compramos. Hoy no existe un departamento de Compras formal: tú lo vas a crear. Empezarás por entender a fondo el negocio, diagnosticar cómo compramos actualmente y transformar esa realidad en una estrategia de categorías con impacto medible en el margen, el servicio y la posición de mercado de RIVUS®.




¿Qué es lo que harás?
Diagnóstico. Analizar a profundidad "la manera de comprar" actual de RIVUS® y todo el portafolio de productos: cómo, a quién y bajo qué condiciones compramos hoy.
Detección de oportunidades. Identificar las oportunidades clave por categoría y por socio fabricante, con una lectura crítica de dónde estamos dejando valor sobre la mesa.
Priorización con datos. Priorizar esas oportunidades a partir de investigación de mercado y del potencial real de cada categoría, no de la intuición.
Estrategia. Diseñar la estrategia de compras y de categorías, su hoja de ruta y la manera de medir su impacto en el negocio.
Procesos. Crear desde cero los procesos, políticas, indicadores y tableros que le den estructura, disciplina y trazabilidad a la función.
Negociación internacional. Negociar con proveedores y socios fabricantes de Estados Unidos, Europa, India y China, entendiendo los códigos y el lenguaje de cada mercado.
Construcción del área. Sentar las bases del futuro departamento de Compras de RIVUS®.




El talento que buscamos

Primero, lo primero — valores y ética profesional. Este punto es innegociable. La función de Compras administra relaciones, información sensible y recursos de la empresa; necesitamos a alguien con integridad demostrada, transparencia y criterio para tomar decisiones correctas incluso cuando nadie está mirando.

Además, buscamos a alguien que reúna:

Mentalidad de procesos. No solo sigue procesos: los diseña, documenta y mejora. Ve la estructura como una forma de escalar, no como burocracia.
Perfil analítico. Capaz de leer datos, portafolios y mercados para convertir información en decisiones y prioridades claras.
Negociación internacional. Experiencia real negociando con proveedores de distintas culturas (USA, Europa, India, China) y sensibilidad para hacerlo de forma efectiva.
Inglés profesional. Nivel para negociar, redactar y sostener conversaciones de negocio con soltura. Es un requisito indispensable.
Experiencia en Compras Indirectas. Idealmente proveniente de Cadena de Suministro, MRO o Manejo de Materiales en empresas grandes, o como comprador(a) en distribuidores multimarca y multicategoría.




Lo que este rol NO es

Para evitar confusión: no estamos contratando a un comprador transaccional de emisión y seguimiento. Buscamos a un(a) estratega que entienda nuestra filosofía y que haga que cada compra fortalezca la venta. Si tu experiencia se limita a colocar pedidos y dar seguimiento, este probablemente no es el rol para ti; si eres capaz de leer un portafolio, construir una estrategia de categorías y negociar como profesional a nivel internacional, queremos conocerte.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across voice, email, and enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z and Base10 with over $60M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments - where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About The Role

At HappyRobot, our partners are a core growth engine — but only if we're rigorous about which opportunities we chase and disciplined about setting partners up to win.

We're looking for a Partnerships Strategy & Enablement Lead to build the system that turns raw partner-sourced opportunities into a prioritized, well-scoped pipeline, and to build the enablement that lets partners qualify, sell, and deploy on their own.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of strategy, commercial structuring, and partner operations. You'll be the person who decides what's worth pursuing, builds the case for it, and makes sure it actually gets delivered.

What We're Looking For


1–3 years of experience in Management Consulting, Strategy, Business Operations, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Chief of Staff, or a high-growth startup
Exceptional structured problem-solving skills
Highly analytical with strong Excel / Google Sheets modeling abilities
Ability to simplify ambiguous problems into clear frameworks and action plans
Excellent written and verbal communication

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it's not "your job." If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don't wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for "just fine." We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it's a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody's watching.

We are "majos"

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. "Majo" is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We're building something ambitious, and it's easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We're running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; 'exceptional performance is the passing grade.' Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that's how we win.

First-Principles Thinking 

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don't copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It's how we build what others think is impossible.

description:
About the job

Junior Strategist 

Remote · Reports to Pod Leader/YouTube Strategist

Knwn Local 

Apply now: https://righteous-chestnut-b59.notion.site/dbf353fd5db582eca4790187f228454a?pvs=105




About Knwn Local: We build organic content brands for real estate agents. YouTube channels, email newsletters, social content. Full service, done for you. We work with 100+ agents across North America and we are scaling fast. Our clients close $10M to $1B+ in sales a year and many of them call their channel the best marketing investment they have ever made. We are scaling from 100 clients toward 300, then 1,000+, and the team has grown past 65 people on the way there.




Role: The Jr. Strategist exists because a Pod Leader cannot run 15+ channels alone. The ideas have to be found, the briefs have to be built, and the scripts and thumbnails have to be reviewed before anything reaches a client. That is this role.




You work directly under a Pod Leader who owns the client relationship, leads the strategy calls, and has final say on everything. Your job is to own the work that makes their job possible. The stronger your briefs, the sharper your reviews, and the more you understand each client, the better the pod performs.




This is also a team role. You are working alongside writers, editors, and designers who are all building toward the same goal. How the content performs is tied to what you bring.




Responsibilities

Handle ideation for 15+ channels. Research ideas, find outliers, write title options, build the thumbnail concept and direction, write the logline, and complete the video outline.
Review every script before it reaches a client. Check the hook, the CTAs, and the conclusion. If something is off, fix it or flag it clearly.
Review every thumbnail before it is finalized. Evaluate the concept, the strategy, and whether it earns the click. If the direction is wrong, say why.
Be on every client call with your Pod Leader. Take real-time notes, add ideas into Notion as the conversation happens, and have a clean action item list ready when the call ends.
Show up to team meetings knowing your numbers and ready to contribute.




Results

60%+ of all ideas for your team are created by you
90%+ of ideas you create are approved by the Pod Leader on the first pass
90%+ of scripts reviewed before they reach a client
90%+ of thumbnails reviewed before they ship
Brief quality improves consistently over time, tracked through Pod Leader feedback




Requirements

Built and managed content across multiple channels or clients simultaneously, where the details were yours to get right
Developed a repeatable ideation process using data, not just gut feel -- can walk through how they find outlier ideas and what makes them confident in one
Reviewed creative work (scripts, thumbnails, or similar) before it reached an audience and caught problems others missed
Worked inside a team-based production environment where missing a deadline affected other people downstream
Can demonstrate a real understanding of YouTube: how videos get traction, what makes a hook land, and how a video generates a lead




Who This Is For: This role is genuinely creative. You are coming up with ideas for 15+ channels every month and those ideas have to keep working for each client over time. You are not just generating volume. You are staying curious about what is performing, watching what other channels are doing, and bringing back ideas that are actually good.




You also have to be organized. There is a lot of independent work here and none of it waits for someone to remind you. You are tracking briefs, reviews, and deadlines across multiple clients at once.




If you like doing deep research, get genuinely excited about finding a concept you know is going to work, and can keep that level of attention across a full client load, this role will feel like a good fit.




It's not for you if you need a lot of direction to get started, want to be making final decisions right now, or do not want to work closely as part of a team.




Schedule: Monday through Friday, core hours aligned with 8am to 5pm Eastern. Some client calls may require flexibility within that window. (Some hours are flexible based on timezone)




Location: Fully remote. Open to candidates internationally




Compensation: $36,000 to $42,000 base salary depending on experience. Reviewed annually. Compensation grows with performance. We are building a performance model where hitting your numbers and continuing to take on more gets rewarded directly. All positions start with a 30 to 90 day paid trial.




Our Core Values

Relentless Curiosity - Learning never stops. You enjoy growth personally and professionally.
Kind Candor - Honest feedback both internally and externally is a gift we gladly receive.
Extreme Ownership - Be the type of person people can always count on, both internally and externally.
Operational Excellence - Be the person who spots what is broken and makes it better.




How to Apply: 

Apply here: https://righteous-chestnut-b59.notion.site/dbf353fd5db582eca4790187f228454a?pvs=105




Pay $36K to 42K USD a year

About the job

Sourcing Specialist Corporative Services 




Objetivo del puesto: 

Gestionar y administrar bajo el enfoque de sourcing estratégico el proceso de compra de equipos (mayor/menor), insumos o servicios, requeridos para las unidades de negocio de Walmart Centroamérica, logrando las mejores oportunidades de abastecimiento y en cumplimiento con los requerimientos del negocio, bajo condiciones del mejor costo total de la adquisición, alta calidad, conveniente tiempo de entrega y un buen servicio post-venta, en apego a las políticas y normas establecidas por la organización, y las definidas por Cumplimiento y Anticorrupción.




Principales responsabilidades: 

Definir el alcance del Proyecto a través de la recopilación de los requerimientos de sus clientes y partes interesadas, con el objetivo de mapear una línea base, asegurar presupuestos, estimar beneficios y determinar riesgos, obteniendo una visión global del Proyecto
Tener dominio y un control de la cartera de proveedores a su cargo, a través de un detalle básico (información general, descripción de la Compañía, segmentos de la industria, países en los que opera, principales competidores, fortalezas y debilidades), con el fin de tener la información disponible para gestionar cualquier negociación que se requiera.
Realizar un análisis de los costos totales de propiedad (TCO) que se acumulan después de la compra y durante el curso de su uso, a través de análisis con los stakeholders, los usuarios y con el mercado, lo cual permitirá tomar una decisión integral sobre la mejor compra.
Garantizar la búsqueda de nuevos proveedores para identificar aquellos potenciales, asegurando la transparencia, un entorno justo y competitivo y facilitar una conversación objetiva en el equipo.
Desarrollar los criterios de evaluación acorde a los requisitos de la estrategia establecida por el Área, con el fin de evaluar de forma objetiva cada negociación.
Establecer un forecast anual de ahorros / beneficios esperados de la categoría, y dar seguimiento a la ejecución y alcance a tiempo de los mismos, a través de un reporte mensual el cual permite demostrar la creación de valor de las compras en resultados financieros.
Asegurar un control absoluto de su categoría, así como la calendarización de proyectos permanentes y temporales, para garantizar la ejecución en tiempo y en regla de toda gestión de compra.




Perfil del puesto:

Licenciatura concluída en áreas comerciales o administrativas, o carrera fin.

Experiencia: 3 años de experiencia en ejecución de compras acorde a la categoría asignada, negociación con proveedores y manejo eficiente de presupuestos.

Conocimientos técnicos: Excel avanzado, SAP Ariba, Power BI, SICI, deseable IA.

Ingles intermedio.




En Walmart de México y Centroamérica estamos comprometidos con una cultura de pertenencia, por lo que buscamos incorporar el mejor talento basándonos en competencias, habilidades y potencial; no discriminamos por ningún motivo, incluyendo género, edad, origen étnico, apariencia física, estado civil, condiciones de salud por VIH o cualquier enfermedad, situación socioeconómica, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género por ello durante el proceso de atracción y selección no solicitaremos información personal, fotografías o análisis clínicos de ningún tipo. Los datos personales del candidato o candidata no son relevantes durante el proceso de entrevista ni para la selección final. En Walmart de México y Centroamérica nos comprometemos con nuestros/as asociados/as para que encuentren día a día en el trabajo un ambiente de respeto, libre de discriminación y acoso sexual.”

title: Customer & Procurement Planner

Coordinate with supplying plants on allocation priorities, capacity constraints, shortages, engineering changes, and EOP transitions.
Monitor inbound order confirmations and proactively escalate mismatches between confirmed and required quantities.
Maintain planning master data: lead times, MOQs, lot sizes, safety stock levels, and MRP controller assignments.
Coordinate inbound receipts, inventory positioning, and stock availability across North American warehouse locations.
Monitor and resolve blocked stock, MRP exceptions, and inventory discrepancies with warehouse operations teams.
Manage goods-in-transit (GIT) visibility and ensure timely clearance of open inbound deliveries.
Support warehouse operations through accurate ASN transmission, delivery scheduling, and outbound shipment prioritization.
Identify slow-moving and obsolete inventory in partnership with warehouse teams; develop disposition strategies.
Manage customer-facing planning for OEM and Tier 1 accounts across automotive, powersports, and commercial vehicle segments.
Process and validate customer EDI releases; ensure accurate system intake and timely order fulfillment.
Transmit and validate Advance Shipping Notifications (ASNs) through customer portals per customer-specific requirements.
Schedule outbound shipments and monitor deliveries through final customer destination.
Proactively communicate supply risks to customers with recovery timelines and viable alternatives.
Support shortage escalations with structured root cause analysis and corrective action documentation.
Execute and manage MRP runs in SAP to generate planned orders and purchase requisitions based on production demand.
Convert MRP requirements into purchase orders or scheduling agreements aligned with supplier lead times and production schedules.
Maintain planning master data: MRP type, lot sizes, lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and MRP controller assignments.
Monitor and action MRP exception messages (expedite, defer, cancel) to keep supply plans aligned with evolving demand.
Maintain data governance standards in SAP for assigned material portfolio, including parameter integrity and proper controller assignment.
Manage purchase orders and scheduling agreements with external suppliers, ensuring on-time delivery to plant locations.
Communicate demand requirements, changes, and escalations to suppliers in a clear and timely manner.
Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively address shortages, late deliveries, and quality holds.
Coordinate with Purchasing and Supplier Quality on corrective actions, capacity constraints, and alternate source qualification.
Support new supplier onboarding and system configuration in ERP.
Monitor stock levels at point-of-use and receiving locations to ensure uninterrupted production supply.
Manage critical shortage situations with structured recovery plans communicated to plant operations and management.
Participate in shortage review meetings with structured updates on open issues and resolution timelines.
Coordinate expedited shipments when necessary; ensure premium freight is justified, approved, and documented.
Track goods-in-transit and ensure timely customs clearance for imported materials.
Maintain inventory levels (DIO) in alignment with working capital and service level objectives.
Perform ABC/XYZ material classification and define inventory strategies based on criticality, demand volatility, and margin.
Identify excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; recommend and execute disposition strategies.
Support safety stock reviews and planning parameter optimization on a defined cadence.
Manage inventory risk through product lifecycle transitions: new launches, engineering changes, and end-of-production.
Monitor and report KPIs relevant to assigned track: OTIF, backlog, premium freight, fill rate, supplier OTD, and DIO.
Analyze forecast vs. actual deviations to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
Prepare structured input for weekly shortage reviews, monthly business reviews (MBR), and customer/plant scorecards.
Develop root cause analysis and corrective action documentation for supply disruptions and service failures.
Use SAP, Kinaxis Maestro, and Power BI to maintain real-time planning and performance visibility.
Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Quality, and Purchasing to align supply plans with business priorities.
Manage premium freight requests through the iStar approval process; ensure spend is justified, documented, and minimized.
Contribute demand and supply input to the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process.

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in supply chain planning, materials management, or procurement within a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Hands-on SAP ERP experience at the transaction level (planning, purchasing, or inventory management context).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and planning scenario modeling (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, etc.).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable planning decisions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to communicate professionally during escalation situations.
Results-oriented with strong ownership mindset, urgency, and attention to detail.
Flexible worker, operates well working both independently and in a team environment.
Automotive OEM or Tier 1 customer experience (e.g., BMW, DTNA, Toyota, Ford, Harley-Davidson, BRP, Polaris).
Experience managing EDI releases, ASN transmission, and customer portal compliance.
Familiarity with managing internal plant-to-plant supplier relationships within a global manufacturing organization.
Experience with premium freight management and cost-reduction disciplines.
Working knowledge of MRP logic, BOM structures, and production planning fundamentals.
Experience with external supplier coordination and scheduling agreement management.
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles (kanban, PFEP, pull systems, standard work).
Experience with foreign supplier coordination, import logistics, or customs compliance basics.

The Supply Chain Planner — Customer & Procurement manages material flow across the North American supply chain on behalf of Bosch customers, plant operations, and internal logistics. Depending on business needs and team structure, this role may be assigned to one or both of the following tracks: Passthrough (Customer) Planning or Procurement (Raw Material) Planning. Planners are expected to develop competency in both areas over time, enabling organizational flexibility as business requirements evolve.

Assignment Note: Individual planners will be designated to a primary track based on team structure and business need. This JD covers both tracks to support role mobility and cross-training across the planning organization.

Track A: Customer & Passthrough Planning

Procure finished goods from global Bosch supplying plants → Manage warehouse inbound → Fulfill OEM/Tier 1 customer demand

A1. Inbound Planning & Procurement from Bosch Supplying Plants


Generate and manage purchase orders and delivery schedules to global Bosch supplying plants based on customer demand and inventory targets.

Maintain planning master data: lead times, MOQs, lot sizes, safety stock levels, and MRP controller assignments.

Monitor and resolve blocked stock, MRP exceptions, and inventory discrepancies with warehouse operations teams.
Manage goods-in-transit (GIT) visibility and ensure timely clearance of open inbound deliveries.
Support warehouse operations through accurate ASN transmission, delivery scheduling, and outbound shipment prioritization.
Identify slow-moving and obsolete inventory in partnership with warehouse teams; develop disposition strategies.


A3. Customer Management & Order Fulfillment


Manage customer-facing planning for OEM and Tier 1 accounts across automotive, powersports, and commercial vehicle segments.
Process and validate customer EDI releases; ensure accurate system intake and timely order fulfillment.
Transmit and validate Advance Shipping Notifications (ASNs) through customer portals per customer-specific requirements.
Schedule outbound shipments and monitor deliveries through final customer destination.
Proactively communicate supply risks to customers with recovery timelines and viable alternatives.
Support shortage escalations with structured root cause analysis and corrective action documentation.


Track B: Procurement & Raw Material Planning

Translate production demand into supplier orders → Ensure uninterrupted material supply → Protect manufacturing continuity

B1. MRP-Driven Procurement Planning


Execute and manage MRP runs in SAP to generate planned orders and purchase requisitions based on production demand.
Convert MRP requirements into purchase orders or scheduling agreements aligned with supplier lead times and production schedules.
Maintain planning master data: MRP type, lot sizes, lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and MRP controller assignments.
Monitor and action MRP exception messages (expedite, defer, cancel) to keep supply plans aligned with evolving demand.
Maintain data governance standards in SAP for assigned material portfolio, including parameter integrity and proper controller assignment.


B2. Supplier Coordination & Order Management


Manage purchase orders and scheduling agreements with external suppliers, ensuring on-time delivery to plant locations.
Communicate demand requirements, changes, and escalations to suppliers in a clear and timely manner.
Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively address shortages, late deliveries, and quality holds.
Coordinate with Purchasing and Supplier Quality on corrective actions, capacity constraints, and alternate source qualification.
Support new supplier onboarding and system configuration in ERP.


B3. Production Supply & Shortage Management


Monitor stock levels at point-of-use and receiving locations to ensure uninterrupted production supply.
Manage critical shortage situations with structured recovery plans communicated to plant operations and management.
Participate in shortage review meetings with structured updates on open issues and resolution timelines.
Coordinate expedited shipments when necessary; ensure premium freight is justified, approved, and documented.
Track goods-in-transit and ensure timely customs clearance for imported materials.


Applies to Both Tracks

Inventory Management & Optimization


Maintain inventory levels (DIO) in alignment with working capital and service level objectives.
Perform ABC/XYZ material classification and define inventory strategies based on criticality, demand volatility, and margin.
Identify excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; recommend and execute disposition strategies.
Support safety stock reviews and planning parameter optimization on a defined cadence.
Manage inventory risk through product lifecycle transitions: new launches, engineering changes, and end-of-production.


Performance Monitoring & Reporting


Monitor and report KPIs relevant to assigned track: OTIF, backlog, premium freight, fill rate, supplier OTD, and DIO.
Analyze forecast vs. actual deviations to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
Prepare structured input for weekly shortage reviews, monthly business reviews (MBR), and customer/plant scorecards.
Develop root cause analysis and corrective action documentation for supply disruptions and service failures.
Use SAP, Kinaxis Maestro, and Power BI to maintain real-time planning and performance visibility.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement


Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Quality, and Purchasing to align supply plans with business priorities.
Manage premium freight requests through the iStar approval process; ensure spend is justified, documented, and minimized.
Contribute demand and supply input to the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process.
Identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities across planning processes, system usage, and cross-functional workflows.


Qualifications

Required - All Planners


Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in supply chain planning, materials management, or procurement within a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Hands-on SAP ERP experience at the transaction level (planning, purchasing, or inventory management context).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and planning scenario modeling (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, etc.).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable planning decisions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to communicate professionally during escalation situations.
Results-oriented with strong ownership mindset, urgency, and attention to detail.
Flexible worker, operates well working both independently and in a team environment.


Preferred - Track A (Passthrough / Customer Planning)


Automotive OEM or Tier 1 customer experience (e.g., BMW, DTNA, Toyota, Ford, Harley-Davidson, BRP, Polaris).
Experience managing EDI releases, ASN transmission, and customer portal compliance.
Familiarity with managing internal plant-to-plant supplier relationships within a global manufacturing organization.
Experience with premium freight management and cost-reduction disciplines.


Preferred - Track B (Procurement / Raw Material Planning)


Working knowledge of MRP logic, BOM structures, and production planning fundamentals.
Experience with external supplier coordination and scheduling agreement management.
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles (kanban, PFEP, pull systems, standard work).
Experience with foreign supplier coordination, import logistics, or customs compliance basics.


Additional Information

About the job

Job Description

At General Motors Mexico, we don’t just build great cars, trucks and crossovers. We design the customer mobility experience. We are developing cutting edge technology on next generation infotainment systems and in-vehicle connectivity. This technology is a key enabler to things like smarter car sharing programs, more advanced active safety and even autonomous driving. The Vehicle and Connected Operations team and its members operate world’s largest 4G LTE network in the automotive industry, supporting millions of connected vehicles and their services. We make sure that system performance can support business objectives. We drive continuous improvement that directly contributes to GM’s bottom line.

About the Operations Engineer role:

This position is responsible for ensuring the systems used to provide GM connected vehicle services are operating and functioning properly and the services are delivered successfully to all active subscribers. This role is highly technical and requires deep understanding of modern telematics system interactions and identifying data elements within these systems that can be used to evaluate wireless performance within the end-to-end system.

The person in this role will work cross-functionally and globally to collaborate with business/product owners, IT development and operations, engineering, and quality teams, to ensure flawless end to end performance for our subscribers. The selected responsibilities would include performing technical validation/analysis, developing system service level objectives for global initiatives, defining requirements for new product launches, detailing technical/validation steps and building analytical tools.

Primary Responsibilities:


Fully understand & document system workflows associated back-end interactions, and entire eco-system, including the wireless network elements used to deliver connected vehicle services.
Investigate end-to-end system performance and customer experience issues and applying sound technical judgment to data for the development of system remedies
Identify current containment systems in place, build and execute a plan to remove.
Ensure adequate system requirements are documented for changes to the system platforms by maintaining a close working relationship with IT, Service Delivery, and Engineering departments
Effectively lead, motivate and facilitate others in group situations and instruct others to improve system and customer performance in the connected car environment
High level of analytical ability to assess and identify appropriate alternative courses of action for definition and resolution where problems are complex
Establish program monitoring to ensure that customer expectations will be achieved
Design and develop performance metrics that represent E2E service delivery performance 
Critically evaluate customer performance issues and design or leverage existing tools to mitigate customer experience impacts.
Design, develop, and implement desktop applications and/or processes to automate routine tasks as necessary to facilitate analysis activities.
Ability to prioritize work with only limited direction from supervisor
Prepare and present project plans, status reports, and cost/benefit analysis to leadership.
Develop Power Bi dashboards according to the needs.
Develop specific data bricks queries for issue investigations



Minimum Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent Engineering or related degree or equivalent experience
Minimum 7 years’ experience in a lead technical role
3+ years of experience in wireless industry, related to CDMA, GSM, UMTS and LTE technologiesProficiency using and interacting with relational database structures and working knowledge of SQL
Advanced english level is required

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.

The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. You will have responsibility for partnering with a small number of assigned accounts, maintaining a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their overall technical and operational health and realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer's key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.

As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

Your Impact


Function as the Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration (and needs) of the customer.
Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, and renewal, and expansion.
Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce Marketing platform by:
Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer
Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer's implementation
Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.
Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.

Minimum Skills


Experienced professional with 5+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, Customer Success Manager, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
Skills for both analyzing technical concepts and translating them into business terms and for mapping business requirements into technical features.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
Coordinate and work closely with high volume events and/or key events for the customer.

Deep understanding of Marketing Cloud, marketing automation, personalization, advertising, and/or marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of Digital Marketing processes, challenges and trends

This position will require you to work from your local Salesforce office 3 to 4 days a week.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
